0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-3, 3rd in the Pacific, 12th in the West) for Portland's 7th game of the season, and Portland has won four of its last five. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, and it lost 1-2 to Phoenix in 2025-26.
